ex.en: These questions are beyond the scope of this chapter.
ex.zh: 这些问题超出了本章的范围。

words.note: scope 表范围或余地，常与 for 连用表有…的余地。

ex.en: She is responsible for training all new staff.
ex.zh: 她负责培训所有新员工。

words.note: responsible for 后接职责，responsible to 表对上级负责。

ex.en: The hotel changes the bed linen every day.
ex.zh: 这家旅馆每天更换床上用品。

words.note: linen 指亚麻布或日用织品，床上用品说 bed linen。

ex.en: Average life expectancy in the country has risen sharply.
ex.zh: 该国的人均预期寿命大幅提高。

words.note: expectancy 多用于 life expectancy 表预期寿命。

ex.en: A single street lamp illuminated the narrow alley.
ex.zh: 一盏路灯照亮了狭窄的小巷。

words.note: illuminate 既表照明也表阐明，名词为 illumination。

ex.en: The luxury liner sailed into the harbour at dawn.
ex.zh: 那艘豪华客轮在黎明时驶入港口。

words.note: liner 指大客轮，也指衬里或垃圾袋内衬。

ex.en: Police were able to identify the suspect from the video.
ex.zh: 警方根据录像认出了嫌疑人。

words.note: identify with sb 表认同某人，identify A as B 表确认。

ex.en: She applied for citizenship after living there for ten years.
ex.zh: 在那里居住十年后，她申请了公民身份。

words.note: citizenship 是 citizen 加 -ship 后缀，表身份或权利。

ex.en: Read the label carefully before taking the medicine.
ex.zh: 服药前请仔细阅读标签。

words.note: label 作动词常用 label sb/sth as，含贴标签之意。

ex.en: The road was slippery after the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨过后路面很滑。

words.note: slippery 指表面滑，a slippery slope 喻指逐步恶化。

ex.en: The online forum allows readers to share their views.
ex.zh: 这个网络论坛让读者可以分享看法。

words.note: forum 复数为 forums 或 fora，指讨论的场所。

ex.en: He spoke of their efforts with open contempt.
ex.zh: 他谈及他们的努力时满是公开的蔑视。

words.note: contempt 后接 for，如 contempt for authority。

ex.en: We may modify the design to cut costs.
ex.zh: 我们也许可以修改设计以降低成本。

words.note: modify 指部分修改，比 change 正式，名词 modification。

ex.en: We should all do more to protect the environment.
ex.zh: 我们都应该为保护环境多做些事。

words.note: environment 指环境，后接 of 表具体范围。

ex.en: Scientists have successfully cloned several species of animals.
ex.zh: 科学家已成功克隆了数种动物。

words.note: clone 作名词指复制品，作动词指无性繁殖。

ex.en: His trembling hands betrayed how nervous he was.
ex.zh: 他颤抖的双手暴露了他有多紧张。

words.note: betray 除“背叛”外，还表无意中流露，如 betray fear。

ex.en: The disease is progressive and has no known cure.
ex.zh: 这种病会逐渐加重，目前没有已知的疗法。

words.note: progressive 指渐进的或进步的，the progressive 指进行时。

ex.en: The government pledged to cut carbon emissions by half.
ex.zh: 政府承诺将碳排放量削减一半。

words.note: pledge 比 promise 正式，可作名词表誓言或质押。

ex.en: Students are exempt from paying the entrance fee.
ex.zh: 学生免交入场费。

words.note: exempt from 后接义务或费用，动词为 exempt sb from。

ex.en: The damage appeared to be the result of a deliberate act.
ex.zh: 这些损坏似乎是故意行为造成的。

words.note: deliberate 作形容词读 -rət，作动词读 -reɪt。

ex.en: Lack of sleep causes both psychological and physiological problems.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足会带来心理和生理两方面的问题。

words.note: physiological 由 physiology 加 -ical 构成，指生理的。

ex.en: A shaft of sunlight fell across the empty room.
ex.zh: 一道阳光照进空荡荡的房间。

words.note: shaft 指杆、轴或竖井，a shaft of light 指一束光。

ex.en: The building was praised for its aesthetic appeal.
ex.zh: 这座建筑因美感而受到称赞。

words.note: aesthetic 指审美，名词为 aesthetics，英式也拼 esthetic。

ex.en: The restaurant has a warm and friendly atmosphere.
ex.zh: 这家餐馆的气氛温馨而友好。

words.note: atmosphere 可指大气，也可指气氛，注意区分。

ex.en: The hall was decorated with flowers and lights.
ex.zh: 大厅用鲜花和彩灯装饰起来。

words.note: decorate 后接 with 表用某物装饰，名词为 decoration。

ex.en: We had to call an electrician to fix the wiring.
ex.zh: 我们只好叫电工来修线路。

words.note: electrician 由 electric 加 -ian 构成，指电气工作者。

ex.en: The country remained under military occupation for years.
ex.zh: 这个国家多年来一直处于军事占领之下。

words.note: occupation 指职业或占领，问职业可说 your occupation。

ex.en: He has a tendency to talk too much.
ex.zh: 他有说话太多的毛病。

words.note: tendency 后接 to do 或 towards，动词为 tend。

ex.en: The company released its annual report on Monday.
ex.zh: 公司在周一发布了年度报告。

words.note: release 可指释放、发布与发行，如 release a film。

ex.en: Each photograph in the book has a short caption.
ex.zh: 书中的每张照片都配有一段简短的说明。

words.note: caption 指图片说明或字幕，动词表“加标题”。
